title: Assimil — French with Ease (113 lessons)
cadence_rule: One new lesson per day on patrol, 6 days/week, in order. Replay yesterday's lesson while driving (shadowing). Active wave (EN->FR back-translation of lesson n-50) from lesson 50, 3x/week, seated or patrol. A lesson advances only after its gate check passes.
how_to_use: Unit payload = {dialogue:[{fr,en}], notes, exercises}. Renderer sends text + slow and normal TTS voice notes. Gate check: back-translation of 3 lines + 1 dictation, 80% to pass.

title: InnerFrench podcast (Hugo Cotton)
cadence_rule: From listening CLB 5. Max 3 episodes/week, one per patrol block. Not before the learner passes A2-level listening sets at 70%.
how_to_use: Units are episodes pulled from the RSS feed (title, mp3 url, description). Renderer sends the link + 5 pre-listening vocab cards generated from the description. Gate check: recall_qna — 3 questions in French about the episode answered by voice/text, graded for language + 1 summary sentence.

title: RFI — Journal en français facile (daily 10-min news)
cadence_rule: From listening CLB 4: 2x/week; from CLB 6: daily on patrol or drive. TCF listening mirrors this register (radio news, announcements).
how_to_use: Latest episode from RSS (title, mp3, summary). Renderer sends mp3 link + headline vocab. Gate check: comprehension_mcq (3 items from the summary) + dictation of one headline sentence.

title: Français Authentique (Johan Tekfak)
cadence_rule: Bridge between Assimil and InnerFrench, CLB 3-5. Max 2/week.
how_to_use: Same as innerfrench: RSS units, recall_qna gate check.

title: Driving drill — Pimsleur structure
cadence_rule: Default driving item, daily. Graduated-interval recall: prompt (EN) -> 4 s pause -> answer (FR) -> repeat. Best for vocabulary chunks, question forms, high-frequency verb forms.
how_to_use: DRILL AUTHOR role writes the script from 1-2 target competencies + up to 12 due FSRS cards. Rendered once to MP3 (segments cached). Post-drive spot check: 5 prompts asked back at the next micro slot.

title: Driving drill — Michel Thomas structure
cadence_rule: Use when introducing a NEW grammar competency (tense, mood, pronoun placement): build sentences step by step, no memorising, each prompt adds one element to the previous.
how_to_use: DRILL AUTHOR role: teach block ≤4 lines, then an expanding sentence chain (je veux -> je veux partir -> je ne veux pas partir -> je ne voulais pas partir…). Spot check after.

title: Driving drill — Language Transfer (thinking method)
cadence_rule: Use for derivation-heavy points: EN->FR cognate patterns (-tion, -ité, -ment), verb families, building tenses from known stems. Max 3/week.
how_to_use: DRILL AUTHOR role: each prompt asks the learner to DERIVE the French from a rule just stated, not recall it. Spot check after.

title: Seated grammar micro-lesson (Kwiziq-style)
cadence_rule: Seated only. Max 2 competencies/day, always the top of v_grammar_weakest that has prerequisites ≥ 60% mastery. Brief (≤180 words) + 6-item adaptive test with typed answers. Item results become weighted grammar evidence.
how_to_use: EXAMINER role writes rule + examples + 6 fill/transform items with expected/accept lists tagged to the competency.

title: TCF Canada task generator (listening/reading sets, writing & speaking tasks, interview)
cadence_rule: Every day at least one graded production task (micro below CLB 4, tcf_* tasks from CLB 4 in that skill). Listening sets on patrol (tap MCQ), reading sets seated. Interview (multi-turn S1/S3 simulation) 2x/week from CLB 4 speaking. Sunday: surprise retention test.
how_to_use: Items carry item_clb; sets are pitched one CLB step above the learner. Grader returns clb_sub per task.
